persona: Calm and clear. Starts without signing in. Has one photo and a printed estimate that does not name her or her car.
initial_message: Hello, I would like to report an accident. On Tuesday 8 September at about 8:20am I was stopped in traffic going up Seaview Test Terrace in Brooklyn, Wellington, and the van in front rolled back into my car. The front bumper and the bonnet are damaged. Nobody was hurt and the other driver gave me her details.

facts.incident.description: I was stopped in a queue of traffic going up the hill. The van in front of me rolled backwards when the driver moved off and hit the front of my car.
facts.incident.cause: The van in front rolled back on the hill as the driver pulled away
facts.loss.description: Front bumper cracked, grille cracked and bonnet edge dented
facts.if_asked_about_fault: She said sorry and said her foot slipped off the brake. We did not talk about who pays.
facts.policyholder.name: Leilani Kauridean
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Front bumper cracked and pushed in below the left headlight, grille cracked, front edge of the bonnet dented
facts.driver.name: Leilani Kauridean
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the front of the car, taken at the scene. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Printed estimate from Iron Bark Motors Workshop dated 10 September 2026, total $1,995.25 including GST. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_quote_details: They printed it at the counter. I did not notice that my name and my car are not on it. I can ask them for a new one later.
facts.if_asked_about_other_insurer: She said she was insured, but I did not write down the company.

The frame shows only the left end of the bumper, the left headlight and the bonnet edge, seen from the side at an angle. No licence plate, no badges, no logos, no text, no people.

design.notes: The repair quote leaves out the customer name and the vehicle, so it cannot be tied to this claim until a complete copy arrives.

triage.rationale: The van in front rolled back into the claimant's car and its driver apologised. Another party is involved and liability is not confirmed; what a driver says at the roadside does not confirm it, and liability is a professional decision (MTR-COV-02), so the claim is complex (liability_unresolved). The repair quote has no customer name and no vehicle, so it cannot be tied to this claim and a complete copy must be chased (evidence_outstanding). The total, $1,995.25 including GST, is printed and under the threshold. Allowed: the claimant does not know the other driver's insurer (question_unanswered). Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

prior_claims_12m.basis: Starts anonymous, signs in before upload; the account has no earlier claims

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (15 June 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2022-06-15, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
